/// An adopter whose projection can fail must answer an operator-initiated request by reloading, then dispatching
/// <see cref="OrderProjectionLoadedAction"/> or <see cref="OrderProjectionLoadFailedAction"/> with this correlation and the scope stamp below.

/// </summary>
